purpose: Source boundary for the 2024-data import (O6/KR6.2). Contains a local byte-identical copy of the char2024 inventory (empty by owner decision, see 'inventory' below) plus a live web-scrape snapshot of dnd2024.wikidot.com raw HTML. Not application runtime data.

inventory.sourceClaim: Owner describes ../char2024 as the pre-refactor 2014 logic snapshot.
inventory.reason: No file-local edition metadata proves a clean ruleset; no bytes were copied.

inventory.sourceClaim: Owner describes ../char2024 as the pre-refactor 2014 logic snapshot.
inventory.reason: The legacy name and file-local data do not prove a clean ruleset; no bytes were copied.

inventory.sourceClaim: README claims a library including PHB/DMG 2024 alongside XGtE and TCoE.
inventory.reason: Mixed-edition source claim; the expected datasets are absent locally and only this README exists.

inventory.sourceClaim: Filename and Wikidot URLs claim 2024, while rows cite Player's Handbook, Eberron, Forgotten Realms, and other sources.
inventory.reason: Mixed editorial sources; no bytes were copied.

inventory.sourceClaim: Title and contents explicitly identify PHB 2024 backgrounds.
inventory.reason: Edition claim is explicit, but the revised scope creates only an empty boundary; no bytes were copied.

webScrapeSnapshots.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (research; spells.holota.family KR6.2 content survey; contact: internal.education@gen.tech)
webScrapeSnapshots.fetchMethod: sequential curl, >=1.5s pause between requests, one page per request
webScrapeSnapshots.licenseNote: Owner decision 2026-08-15 (docs/o6-rules-2024-import/kr6.1-discovery.md §3): source is wider than SRD 5.2 (CC-BY-4.0), risk accepted consciously as the same risk already accepted for the 2014 content. SRD 5.2 remains the cross-check reference where an entity is covered by it; any disagreement is resolved in favor of SRD text, recorded in the divergence report.
webScrapeSnapshots.scopeNote: Phase 1 of KR6.2 (owner-scoped 2026-08-15, AskUserQuestion 'Core structural content first'): species, backgrounds, feats, weapon/armor equipment reference tables, class overview pages, subclasses, and a targeted spell diff (renamed/new candidates only, not the full spell corpus). Full spell corpus (~419 wiki pages beyond the diff set) and the magic item catalog (418 wiki pages) are explicitly deferred to a follow-up KR6.2 session — see journal and docs/o6-rules-2024-import/kr6.2-extraction-translation.md.
webScrapeSnapshots.classificationMethod: Each entity page on this wiki declares an explicit 'Source: <book>' line. Pages tagged 'Player's Handbook' are classified phb-2024-core (in scope for this KR). Pages tagged with any other book (Forgotten Realms - Heroes of Faerun, Ravenloft - The Horrors Within, Eberron - Forge of the Artificer, D&D Beyond Drops - <month>) are classified other-2024-sourcebook (out of scope — later supplements, not core PHB 2024). Index/listing pages (*:all) and aggregate reference tables (equipment:weapon, equipment:armor) have no single-entity source tag and are classified separately.
webScrapeSnapshots.byteIdentityVerificationMethod: Re-hashed all saved files immediately after fetch; 0 mismatches against recorded sha256/byteSize.

webScrapeSnapshots.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (research; spells.holota.family KR6.2 content survey; contact: internal.education@gen.tech)
webScrapeSnapshots.fetchMethod: sequential curl, >=1.7s pause between requests, one page per request
webScrapeSnapshots.licenseNote: Same owner decision as prior snapshots (KR6.1 §3): source wider than SRD 5.2, risk accepted consciously.
webScrapeSnapshots.scopeNote: Phase 4 of KR6.2 (owner-scoped 2026-08-15, AskUserQuestion 'scrape + classify only, no translation'): full magic-item namespace (396 candidate entity pages found via magic-item:all, plus the magic-item:all index and the magic-item:sources navigation page and its 7 non-core-sourcebook sub-pages). Classification only — translation deferred to a follow-up session; see data/2024/normalized/magic-items.json (translationStatus: "not started" on every record) and docs/o6-rules-2024-import/kr6.2-extraction-translation.md §Phase 4.
webScrapeSnapshots.classificationMethod: Same 'Source: <book>' per-entity-page method as prior snapshots, with one correction discovered this phase: 2024 magic items are sourced from the Dungeon Master's Guide, not the Player's Handbook (unlike every other KR6.2 category). 'dmg-2024-core' = Source: Dungeon Master's Guide OR Source: Player's Handbook (exactly one item, Potion of Healing, is genuinely PHB-tagged — a starting-equipment reprint). All other Source: values (Eberron - Forge of the Artificer, Netheril's Fall, Forgotten Realms - Adventures in Faerun, Forgotten Realms - Heroes of Faerun, Welcome to the Hellfire Club, D&D Beyond Drops - <month>, Ravenloft - The Horrors Within, Lorwyn - First Light, Uni and the Hunt for the Lost Horn) are 'other-2024-sourcebook'. The magic-item:sources navigation page lists only 7 of these 9 non-core sourcebooks — 'Welcome to the Hellfire Club' and 'Uni and the Hunt for the Lost Horn' (5 items total) are missing from it entirely, confirmed by direct per-page Source: check, not by trusting the navigation page.
webScrapeSnapshots.byteIdentityVerificationMethod: Re-hashed all saved files immediately after fetch; 0 mismatches against recorded sha256/byteSize.
